description: Use when you need text to speech, tts, a voice audio file or spoken narration of a short text. Do not use for voice cloning, a chosen voice, SSML or audio longer than about two minutes. Returns JSON with text to speech (TTS): your text read aloud as WAV voice audio (base64, 44.1 kHz mono) by MeloTTS on Workers AI, in English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese or Korean for 0.023 USDC per call. Typical response time 8000 ms (p95). Category: Media. Price: US$0.023 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

lang.description: Speech language: en (default), es, fr, zh, ja or ko

text.description: Text to read aloud, e.g. Welcome to our store (up to 1000 characters)
